whatsappMessage:
Hi Ayansh Fitness Point Team,

I noticed your gym has exceptional 4.9★ reviews from 200+ members in Munger, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for new membership inquiries.

Maine aapke gym ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp trial booking, workout programs, aur batch timings integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/ayanshfitness

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Ayansh Fitness Point Team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! Humne ise specifically aapke 4.9-star rating aur Kasim Bazar, Munger ke local members ke liye direct WhatsApp booking aur modern mobile layout ke sath design kiya hai. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact services, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
